summary: Frontend-only E2E of LectureLens iteration 2, focused on the two NEW features (Multi-Lecture Vault + Study Export) plus regression on the MVP. 13/13 targeted checks passed. All AI answers ran through the offline keyword search (no Gemini keys), as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: App.jsx handleSend still snapshots history from `chats.find(activeId).messages` prior to the setChats commit — fine for the current UX but ordering could be brittle on rapid multi-turn sends.
exportNotes.js CITE_RE is fine but relies on a stateful `lastIndex` reset each call — kept correct here; keep an eye on any refactor that adds `/g` reuse in parallel.

resolveEvidence blindly builds a frame_MMSS.jpg path per lecture — for new lectures only 5 frames exist (0000/0030/0100/0130/0200); fallback via keeps this from breaking, but nearest-match to available frames would be nicer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) 3-column layout + blank greeting + 3 quick chips; (2) lecture-switcher opens lecture-menu listing 3 options; (3) selecting neural-nets updates active-lecture-chip to 'Neural Networks 101', creates a new empty chat, subtitle mentions the new lecture, quick prompts show perceptron/backprop/network; (4) neural quick prompt yields an offline answer mentioning perceptron/weights/network (no wavy/Snell), citation pill loads evidence-frame whose src starts with /frames/neural-nets/; (5) photosynthesis switch answer mentions Calvin/chloroplast, evidence-frame src /frames/photosynthesis/; (6) sidebar chat items carry per-lecture colored dots and clicking a chat from a different lecture flips the active-lecture-chip back to that chat's lecture; (7) Export Notes button disabled on empty chat, enabled after Q/A; clicking opens a new window/tab with title ' — LectureLens Revision Notes', 3 figures, and Q/A body (window.print dialog auto-triggers after ~400ms); (8) exactly one chat on first load, New Chat button adds another, reload preserves chat count.
